摘要Abstract

确保自动驾驶的安全是一项严峻的挑战。基于场景的测试是一个系统化的过程，用于验证Ensuring the safety of autonomous driving is a critical challenge. Scenario-based testing is a systematic process used to validate自动驾驶系统 (ADS)Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs)，但它仍然是一个支离破碎的模块化管道，其中场景生成、检索、修改、, but it remains a fragmented modular pipeline in which scenario generation, retrieval, modification,ADS执行和结果分析由单独的工具执行，几乎没有交互。execution, and results analysis are performed by separate tools with little interaction.大语言模型（LLM）Large Language Model (LLM)代理商已展现出承诺agents have shown promise acrossADS感知、规划和控制等子系统。然而，之前的工作还没有涵盖整个基于场景的测试流程sub-systems such as perception, planning, and control. However, no prior work covers the whole scenario-based testing pipeline forADSADSs具有统一的with a unified法学硕士LLM-代理框架。 我们呈现-agent framework. We present规划师锻造PlannerForge, 一个, an法学硕士LLM-代理框架，扩展所有基于场景的测试阶段（从场景生成到-agent framework that extends all scenario-based testing stages (from Scenario Generation toADS评估）并添加了另外两个Assessment) and adds two further法学硕士LLM- 增强阶段：-enhanced stages:ADS增强和Enhancement andADS基准测试。我们使用 10 个现成的工具来评估 PlannerForgeBenchmarking. We evaluate PlannerForge with 10 off-the-shelf法学硕士LLMs在 5 个提示条件下执行所有任务（生成、选择、修改、模块路由、规划器测试和增强）。每个任务的最佳分数范围为 0.88 到 1.00，开源 20-35B 后端在大多数任务上与商业 API 相匹配。 Qwen3.6:35B 等开源模型在五个任务中的三个上与商业 API 相匹配。 端到端链接模块保留了 83% / 78% 的种子查询（商业/开放）。它的性能优于 Scenario Factory 2.0across all tasks (Generation, Selection, Modification, Module Routing, Planner Testing, and Enhancement) under 5 prompt conditions. Best-per-task scores range from 0.88 to 1.00, and open-source 20–35B backends match commercial APIs on most tasks. Open-source models such as Qwen3.6:35B match commercial APIs on three of the five tasks. Chaining the modules end-to-end retains 83% / 78% of seed queries (commercial / open). It outperforms Scenario Factory 2.0(Finkeldei et al., 2025)自然语言生成（193 个与 200 个可执行文件中的 144 个）并实现了 92-96% 的所需城市、道路和车辆属性。性能优于BM25on natural-language generation (193 vs. 144 executable of 200) and realises 92–96% of requested city, road and vehicle attributes. It outperforms BM25(Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009)排名 1 的选择（92.0% 与 67.5%）和从单词到冲突at rank 1 selection (92.0% vs. 67.5%) and From-Words-to-Collisions(Gao et al., 2025)物理上有效的编辑（on physically valid edits (≥\geq94% 与 31%）。在94% vs. 31%). AtN=400N{=}400，成本调整将规划器的成功率从 50.4% 提升到 70.2%，并将冲突从 19.0% 减少到 8.4%，而无需针对特定领域进行微调。, cost-tuning lifts planner success from 50.4% to 70.2% and cuts collisions from 19.0% to 8.4%, without domain-specific fine-tuning.

However, anADS评估管道需要更多：它必须无缝集成相关案例的选择、测试的执行和结果的分析assessment pipeline requires significantly more: it must seamlessly integrate the selection of relevant cases, the execution of tests, and the analysis of resultsSong et al. (2026).

在当前的运动规划器测试实践中，这些阶段仍然高度分散和手动。场景生成依赖于 GUI 编辑器或脚本，选择依赖于手工制作的数据库过滤器，并且很大程度上不支持临时场景修改。此外，测试管道是严格编写脚本的，而不是由用户意图引导的，规划器成本权重是手动调整的，跨规划器比较需要单独编写脚本的批处理运行和离线聚合。为了克服这些瓶颈，显然需要一个统一的、In current motion-planner testing practice, these stages remain highly fragmented and manual. Scenario generation relies on GUI editors or scripts, selection depends on hand-crafted database filters, and ad-hoc scenario modification is largely unsupported. Furthermore, testing pipelines are rigidly scripted rather than guided by user intent, planner cost weights are manually tuned, and cross-planner comparisons require separately scripted batch runs with offline aggregation. To overcome these bottlenecks, there is a clear need for a unified,法学硕士LLM- 支持的框架跨越并自动化基于场景的测试的整个生命周期。-powered framework that spans and automates the entire lifecycle of scenario-based testing.

在本文中，我们介绍In this paper, we introduce规划师锻造PlannerForge，一个由法学硕士支持的基于场景的运动规划测试框架，弥补了这一差距（图, an LLM-powered scenario-based testing framework for motion planners that closes this gap (Figure1）。我们的目标是运动规划器，因为它们是运动的核心决策模块). We target motion planners because they are the core decision-making module of anADS他们的行为对复杂、安全关键的交通场景特别敏感。与之前狭隘地关注场景生成的工作不同，PlannerForge 集成了完整的测试流程：场景and their behavior is particularly sensitive to complex, safety-critical traffic scenarios. Unlike prior work that focuses narrowly on scenario generation, PlannerForge integrates the full testing pipeline: scenario一代generation来自现实世界from real-world开放街道地图 (OSM)OpenStreetMap (OSM) 11 1 https://www.openstreetmap.org/地图、从精选的开源场景数据库中检索场景、通过交通对象和行为更改进行场景修改、运动规划器执行和性能分析。面向聊天机器人的界面抽象化了技术复杂性，同时实现了不同运动规划器的无缝集成，为研究人员和从业者提供了一个可扩展、可进行基准测试的平台maps, scenario retrieval from a curated open-source scenario database, scenario modification via traffic object and behavior changes, motion planner execution, and performance analysis. A chatbot-oriented interface abstracts away technical complexity while enabling the seamless integration of diverse motion planners, providing researchers and practitioners with a scalable, benchmark-ready platform forADS评估。assessment.

4.3 场景生成模块Scenario Generation Module

当数据库场景不足时，PlannerForge 通过两阶段管道从头开始生成新的 CommonRoad 场景。安When database scenarios are insufficient, PlannerForge generates new CommonRoad scenarios from scratch via a two-stage pipeline. An法学硕士LLM将自然语言请求解析为结构化意图，将现实世界的道路拓扑与程序模拟的交通相结合。parses natural-language requests into structured intents, combining real-world road topologies with procedurally simulated traffic.

An法学硕士LLM用提示解析这个parses this with prompt𝐏gen\mathbf{P}_{\textsc{gen}}转化为结构化 JSON 意图，指定位置（城市或边界框）、可行驶道路类别、交通密度、车辆组合和模拟持续时间。边界框通过 Overpass API 驱动 OpenStreetMap 查询into a structured JSON intent specifying location (city or bounding box), drivable road classes, traffic density, vehicle mix, and simulation duration. The bounding box drives an OpenStreetMap query via the Overpass APIHaklay and Weber (2008);返回的路网在 SUMO 中进行模拟; the returned road network is simulated in SUMOLopez et al. (2018)然后转换为CommonRoadand then converted to CommonRoadAlthoff et al. (2017)格式。微观相扑模拟在网络中填充了车辆、卡车、公共汽车和其他可配置的参与者类型，产生遵循汽车跟随和变道动态的轨迹。format. A microscopic SUMO simulation populates the network with vehicles, trucks, buses, and other configurable actor types, producing trajectories that respect car-following and lane-changing dynamics.

第 2 阶段：规划问题综合。Stage 2: Planning problem synthesis.从填充的场景中，用户选择自我车辆和目标区域；的From the populated scenario, the user selects an ego vehicle and a goal region; the法学硕士LLM也可能会使用以下策略来建议自我候选人may also suggest an ego candidate using strategies such as第一辆车first car, 按类型by type, 或, or按索引by index。然后通过附加初始状态（自我当前的姿势）和目标区域（选择的车道或沿着自我轨迹的前向偏移）来合成规划问题。结果保存为标准 CommonRoad 场景文件，可供下游修改、测试和分析。. A planning problem is then synthesized by attaching an initial state (the ego’s current pose) and a goal region (either a chosen lanelet or a forward offset along the ego’s trajectory). The result is saved as a standard CommonRoad scenario file ready for downstream modification, testing, and analysis.

Chained end-to-end, the pipeline retains 83% / 78% of seed queries (commercial / open). Open-source 20–35B models perform slightly lower than commercial APIs but are fully capable of driving the entire pipeline. Notably, applying additional prompting techniques to open-source models with native reasoning (e.g., Think variants) disrupts their internal reasoning (Fig.5），增加延迟和令牌消耗，同时降低性能。), increasing latency and token consumption while degrading performance.

总的来说，法学硕士购买了一代中的属性控制，等级1精度 在“选择”中，在“修改”中进行物理有效的编辑，以及在“默认”之上的提升 在增强方面，以秒和代币为代价，这是经典工具所不具备的 付钱。Taken together, the LLM buys attribute control in Generation, rank-1 precision in Selection, physically valid edits in Modification, and a lift over Default in Enhancement, at a cost in seconds and tokens that the classical tools do not pay.

6 结论和未来的工作Conclusion and Future Work

我们提出了We presented规划师锻造PlannerForge，全生命周期, a full-lifecycle法学硕士LLM-用于基于场景的运动规划器测试的代理框架，具有模块路由器、模式检查模块和统一的运动规划器接口。在 80,000 个没有进行微调的现成调用中，模块得分从 0.88（选择）到 1.00（规划器测试），其中生成为 0.957，标题检查的修改接近 100%，路由器为 0.997。从生成到增强的端到端链接保留了 83% / 78% 的种子查询（商业/开放）。与 Scenario Factory 2.0、BM25 和 From-Words-to-Collisions 相比，它在生成时更忠实于属性（193 与 144 个可执行文件），在 1 级选择时更精确（92.0% 与 67.5%），并且在修改时物理上有效（-agent framework for scenario-based testing of motion planners, with a Module Router, schema-checked modules, and a unified motion planner interface. Across 80,000 off-the-shelf calls with no fine-tuning, modules score from 0.88 (Selection) to 1.00 (Planner Testing), with Generation at 0.957, Modification near 100% on the headline checks, and the Router at 0.997. End-to-end chaining from Generation through Enhancement retains 83% / 78% of seed queries (commercial / open). Against Scenario Factory 2.0, BM25, and From-Words-to-Collisions, it is more attribute-faithful in generation (193 vs. 144 executable), more precise at rank 1 selection (92.0% vs. 67.5%), and physically valid in modification (≥\geq94% 与 31%）。在规划器安全关键性能方面，生成的场景会引发 20.0% 的冲突，而场景工厂 2.0 则为 6.1%，并且根据默认值进行成本调整94% vs. 31%). On planner safety-critical performance, generated scenarios induce 20.0% collisions versus 6.1% for Scenario Factory 2.0, and cost-tuning against Default atN=400N{=}400将成功率从 50.4% 提升至 70.2%，同时将碰撞率从 19.0% 降低至 8.4%。未来的工作将关闭规划器循环并将框架扩展到 CARLA 等模拟器。lifts success from 50.4% to 70.2% while cutting collisions from 19.0% to 8.4%. Future work will close the planner loop and extend the framework to simulators such as CARLA.

道德考虑Ethical Considerations

PlannerForge 由现成的驱动PlannerForge is driven by off-the-shelf法学硕士LLM可以产生结构化输出幻觉的代理。在我们的评估中，这表现为发明的场景标签、无效的地图或车辆标识符、错误路由的模块调用以及运行日志不支持的分析声明。如果不加以控制，此类错误可能会产生无效的测试或误导规划人员的诊断。因此，每个评分模块都会在模型输出被接受之前对其进行解析、模式验证和执行。如果检查不完整，则仍然存在残余风险，特别是未评分的分析模块。agents that can hallucinate structured outputs. In our evaluation this appears as invented scenario tags, invalid map or vehicle identifiers, misrouted module calls, and Analysis claims that are not supported by the run logs. Unchecked, such errors can produce invalid tests or misleading planner diagnostics. Every scored module therefore parses, schema-validates, and executes the model output before it is accepted. Residual risk remains where that check is incomplete, in particular the unscored Analysis module.

A.2 场景生成模块Scenario Generation Module

A.2.1 法学硕士范围和幻觉隔离LLM Scope and Hallucination Isolation

生成模块分离The Generation Module separates语言级别language-level任务（由tasks (handled by the法学硕士LLM）来自) from几何级和动态级geometric- and dynamic-level任务（由确定性工具处理）。这种分割是一个经过深思熟虑的设计选择：它保留了自然语言场景创作的灵活性，同时防止法学硕士的幻觉传播到地图拓扑或车辆动力学中。tasks (handled by deterministic tools). This split is a deliberate design choice: it preserves the flexibility of natural-language scenario authoring while preventing LLM hallucinations from propagating into map topology or vehicle dynamics.

法学硕士的职责。LLM responsibilities.

的The法学硕士LLM在两个类型正确的边界处调用：is invoked at two well-typed boundaries:

  • •

    第一阶段——意图解析。Stage 1 — intent parsing.自由格式的话语被解析为具有固定键的 JSON 意图：位置（城市或显式边界框）、可行驶道路类别（OSM 的子集）The free-form utterance is parsed into a JSON intent with fixed keys: location (city or explicit bounding box), drivable road classes (subset of OSM高速公路highway标签）、流量密度（类别：tags), traffic density (categorical:低low/中等medium/高high）、车辆组合（每), vehicle mix (counts perv类vClass）和模拟持续时间。每个键都有一个模式定义的默认值，当 LLM 省略或发出无效值时应用该默认值。表中报告了每个密钥的默认合规率), and simulation duration. Each key has a schema-defined default that is applied when the LLM omits or emits an invalid value. The per-key defaults-compliance rates are reported in Table7.

  • •

    第二阶段——自我选择。Stage 2 — ego selection.从拥挤的流量中，法学硕士选择三种策略之一（From the populated traffic, the LLM picks one of three strategies (第一辆车first car, 按类型by type, 或, or按索引by index）来识别自我车辆。然后目标区域被确定性地附加（) to identify an ego vehicle. The goal region is then attached deterministically (选定的小巷chosen lanelet or 沿着自我轨迹向前偏移forward offset along the ego trajectory).

确定性工具的职责。Deterministic-tool responsibilities.

三个下游阶段无需法学硕士参与即可执行：Three downstream stages execute without LLM involvement:

  • •

    OSM/立交桥获取OSM/Overpass fetch将边界框作为输入并返回相应的takes the bounding box as input and returns the corresponding.osm数据，具有镜像端点故障转移（§data, with mirror-endpoint failover (§A.1).

  • •

    CR-SUMO 转换CR–SUMO conversion Althoff et al. (2017); Lopez et al. (2018)将 OSM 地图转换为 CommonRoad 场景（transforms the OSM map into a CommonRoad scene (.cr.xml）和 SUMO 道路网络（) and a SUMO road network (.net.xml).

  • •

    微观相扑模拟Microscopic SUMO simulation根据法学硕士解析的车辆组合和密度，用背景流量填充网络；由此产生的轨迹通过构建满足汽车跟随和变道动态。populates the network with background traffic according to the vehicle mix and density parsed by the LLM; the resulting trajectories satisfy car-following and lane-changing dynamics by construction.

幻觉隔离。Hallucination isolation.

由于法学硕士从不直接发出地图几何、道路网络拓扑或车辆轨迹，因此从结构上排除了三类幻觉，否则会导致无声的下游故障：Because the LLM never emits map geometry, road-network topology, or vehicle trajectories directly, three classes of hallucination that would otherwise cause silent downstream failure are structurally ruled out:

  • •

    无效的 Lanelet ID 或拓扑（只有转换器生成这些）；invalid lanelet IDs or topologies (only the converter produces these);

  • •

    运动学上不可行的轨迹（只有 SUMO 产生这些）；kinematically infeasible trajectories (only SUMO produces these);

  • •

    对不存在的映射片段的引用（只有 OSM 获取会产生这些）。references to non-existent map fragments (only the OSM fetch produces these).

其余的 LLM 端故障模式（错误解析的位置、错误的流量密度级别、缺少自我说明符）在模式验证时被捕获，并且要么应用默认值，要么作为错误出现。每键通过率显示在The remaining LLM-side failure modes (mis-parsed location, wrong traffic-density level, missing ego specifier) are caught at schema-validation time and either default-applied or surfaced as an error. Per-key pass rates appear in the可加载的loadable表的列column of Table7.

A.2.2 查询语料库Query Corpus

生成模块基准测试使用The Generation Module benchmark usesN=200N=200自然语言查询的中位长度为 8 个单词（p10 = 5，p90 = 11，max = 23）。经常请求的城市包括上海、马德里、科隆、首尔和伦敦。语料库分为两个报告桶：natural-language queries with a median length of 8 words (p10 = 5, p90 = 11, max = 23). Frequently requested cities include Shanghai, Madrid, Cologne, Seoul, and London. The corpus splits into two reporting buckets:

  • •

    清洁CLEAN (n=158n=158) – 标准汽车自我查询。这些练习了规范的管道并主导了头条新闻。) – standard car-ego queries. These exercises the canonical pipeline and dominate the headline numbers.

  • •

    对抗性ADVERSARIAL (n=42n=42) – 明确要求非汽车自我的查询，分为摩托车/轻便摩托车 (23)、自行车/货运自行车/骑车人 (16) 和踏板车/电动踏板车 (3)。这个桶探测了 Frenetix 计划的自我的系统规则) – queries that explicitly request a non-car ego, split as motorcycle/moped (23), bicycle/cargo bike/cyclist (16), and scooter/e-scooter (3). 自动记录遥测。Auto-recorded telemetry.

对于每个 LLM 调用，我们记录提示、完成和（在提供者公开的情况下）推理令牌计数、总令牌计数、每次调用 API 延迟以及完整的每次查询挂钟（其中还包括解析和模拟开销）。这些列在每个任务的 KPI 摘要中显示不变，让我们将“LLM 正确完成了工作”（语义检查）与“LLM 足够快可部署”（延迟/令牌成本）分开。For each LLM invocation, we record prompt, completion, and (where the provider exposes it) reasoning token counts, the total token count, the per-invocation API latency, and the full per-query wall-clock (which also includes parsing and simulation overhead). These columns appear unaltered in the per-task KPI summaries and let us decouple “the LLM did its job correctly” (semantic checks) from “the LLM was fast enough to be deployable” (latency/token cost).

使用漏斗诊断故障。Diagnosing failures with the funnel.

这两个阶段将不同的故障模式解耦：高语义正确性和低 SUMO 可模拟性表明语义正确的编辑会产生结构脆弱的路线（例如，已连接但不允许车辆类别的目标边缘），而一致的低语义检查表明模型无法识别正确的锚字段或发出格式错误的 XML/JSON。因此，这两条路径需要不同的修复（网络感知提示与更严格的输出格式提示），其中每个任务每个检查表§The two stages decouple distinct failure modes: high semantic correctness with low SUMO simulability indicates a semantically correct edit that produces a structurally fragile route (e.g. a target edge that is connected but disallows the vehicle’s class), while uniformly low semantic checks indicate a model that either fails to identify the right anchor field or emits malformed XML/JSON. The two paths, therefore, call for different fixes (network-aware prompting vs. stricter output-format prompting), which the per-task per-check tables in §A.4.3独立表面。surface independently.

Planner 测试和增强任务通过六阶段漏斗根据The Planner Testing and Enhancement task is graded by a six-stage funnel against theGTYAML，加上下游模拟器可运行性检查：YAML, plus a downstream simulator-runnability check:

  • •

    YAML %：模型输出解析为 YAML 映射。: the model output parses as a YAML mapping.

    结构%struct %：存在 13 个成本权重键和 3 个外部成本权重键，其名称和顺序与输入相同: the 13 cost weights keys and 3 external cost weights keys are present, with identical names and ordering to the input成本.yamlcost.yaml.

  • •

    预设%preset %：关于查询: on queries whoseGT带有指定的预设，每个成本重量都在相对容差范围内与预设的表格值相匹配carries a named preset, every cost weight matches the preset’s tabulated value within relative tolerance10−310^{-3}.

  • •

    显式%explicit %：关于查询: on queries whoseGT携带显式（键，值）对，每个命名参数匹配carries explicit (key, value) pairs, each named parameter matchesGT在相对耐受范围内within relative tolerance10−310^{-3}.

  • •

    完整 YAML %full-YAML % (标题headline)：最严格的阶段：发出的 YAML 中的每个值都匹配): the strictest stage: every value in the emitted YAML matchesGT在相对耐受范围内within relative tolerance10−310^{-3}（结合了前两个阶段加上未更改的默认值）。(combines the previous two stages plus untouched defaults).

  • •

    拒绝%refused %：在 9 个查询的词汇外切片上，模型拒绝发出 YAML，而是显示拒绝标记（例如“不”、“不是有效参数”）。: on the 9-query out-of-vocab slice, the model declines to emit a YAML and instead surfaces a refusal token (e.g. “do not”, “not a valid parameter”).

复合材料The composite整体Overall分数是每个查询布尔检查的平均值。作为额外的下游检查，我们针对配对的基线可模拟场景对每个发出的 YAML 运行 Frenetix；达到目标或达到模拟水平而没有崩溃的结果都算作可运行。score is the mean of the per-query boolean checks. As an additional downstream check we run Frenetix on every emitted YAML against a paired baseline-simulable scenario; an outcome of either reaching the goal or hitting the simulation horizon without a crash counts as runnable.

A.7 跨规划器定性比较Cross-Planner Qualitative Comparison

PlannerForge 公开了相同的五种驾驶模式预设（PlannerForge exposes the same five driving-mode presets (默认Default, 舒适度Comfort, 平衡Balanced, 运动型Sporty, 安全Safety）对于基于采样的 Frenetix 规划器和基于学习的 MP-RBFN 规划器。图) for both the sampling-based Frenetix planner and the learning-based MP-RBFN planner. Figure13比较每个规划者的每种模式的成本权重概况。这两个规划器使用不同的成本词汇表：Frenetix 公开 13 个命名权重（加速度、加加速度轴、路径长度、车道中心偏移、速度偏移、到参考路径和障碍物的距离、预测、责任），而 MP-RBFN 公开七个以其径向基础表示为关键的归一化通道（到边界的距离、到参考路径的距离、方向/速度偏移、障碍物预测）。尽管架构存在差异，但这五个共享预设在两个规划器中产生相同的相对形状：compares each planner’s per-mode cost-weight profile. The two planners operate on different cost vocabularies: Frenetix exposes thirteen named weights (acceleration, jerk axes, path-length, lane-centre offset, velocity offset, distances to reference path and to obstacles, prediction, responsibility), while MP-RBFN exposes seven normalised channels keyed on its radial-basis representation (distance-to-boundary, distance-to-reference-path, orientation/velocity offsets, obstacle prediction). Despite the schema differences, the five shared presets produce the same relative shape in both planners:运动型Sporty提高速度偏移权重，同时放宽障碍物预测。drives the velocity-offset weight up while loosening obstacle prediction.安全Safety将障碍物和预测权重推至最大值；drives the obstacle and prediction weights to their maxima;舒适度Comfort平衡方向和侧向冲击重量。balances orientation and lateral-jerk weights.平衡Balanced位于他们之间。在框架生成的场景上对 Frenetix 与 MP-RBFN 进行头对头的定量比较是正在进行的扩展的一部分。定性对应关系如图lies between them. A head-to-head quantitative Frenetix vs MP-RBFN comparison on framework-generated scenarios is part of an ongoing extension. The qualitative correspondence in Figure13确定该框架的自然语言预设界面适用于所有规划器系列。establishes that the framework’s natural-language preset interface generalises across planner families.

The Analysis Module reports success rate and mean runtime side-by-side, and can further diagnose specific failure reasons (e.g., collisions vs. timeouts) for each planner.
